children.name: The MyUPRR iOS app is a free tool for Union Pacific customers to track rail shipments, manage service issues, and receive notifications (e.g., Bad Order, Storage) in real-time. It requires an existing MyUPRR user ID to access features like checking shipment status and updating service requests.  Key Features & Troubleshooting: Shipment Tracking: View current status and locations of rail shipments. Service Management: Create, review, and update service issues. Notifications: Receive alerts on Bad Order, Chargeable Storage, and Service Interruptions.

children.name: The ExpressNS+ app by Norfolk Southern is a mobile tool designed for intermodal truck drivers to streamline terminal procedures, reducing gate times and managing missions electronically. It allows pre-submission of data, QR code scanning for entry, and provides precise terminal navigation.  Key Features of ExpressNS+ Faster Gate Times: Use QR codes to speed up,Ingate and Outgate, bypassing traditional kiosks. Pre-Gate & Mission Management: Submit information before arrival and manage,pickup/drop-off missions. Terminal Navigation: Access GPS features to find specific parking and,equipment locations. Electronic Receipts: Automatically generate and store J1 receipts within the app. Damage Reporting: Report equipment damage using the app's camera.

children.name: The Norfolk Southern NS Trax app for iOS is a free,, business-oriented tool that allows customers to manage shipping and logistics in real-time. Designed for iPhones with iOS 11.0 or later, it offers features such as tracking shipments, viewing waybills, managing watchlists, ordering cars, and browsing exceptions, serving as a mobile extension of the AccessNS desktop portal.  Key Features of NS Trax for iOS: Real-time Tracking: Monitor shipment movements and view pipeline information. Shipment Management: Order and release cars, and manage a watchlist for priority tracking. Equipment Search: Search for specific equipment/railcars within the NS network. Information Access: View detailed waybill information and local service data. Exception Handling: Identify and address shipping exceptions

children.name: The ShipCSX iOS app provides registered CSX customers with mobile access to trace rail shipments, check equipment locations, and manage logistics via iPhone. Key features include Trace, Train Trace, and XGate for terminal efficiency. It requires valid login credentials and is designed for supply-chain management.  Key Features of the ShipCSX App: Tracking Tools: Access real-time updates using Trace by equipment, location, or train, as well as a redesigned map feature. XGate: Allows trucking partners to manage freight drop-offs and pickups at CSX terminals efficiently. Inventory Management: Enables users to submit switch requests. Access Requirements: Requires active ShipCSX login credentials for security purposes.

children.name: The CN One Mobile App, developed by the Canadian National Railway Company, enables registered customers to track carload and intermodal shipments in real-time. It provides shipment status, ETAs, and map views for logistics management. Users must have a registered CN One eBusiness account to access the app's features.  Key Features of CN One Mobile App: Shipment Tracking: Monitor shipment status and ETAs while on the go. Multiple Views: View shipment data in map or list formats. Search Capabilities: Search shipments by ID and other parameters.

children.name: The BNSF RailPASS mobile app for iOS  accelerates intermodal facility gate transactions for truck drivers, reducing time by over 50%. It allows drivers to pre-gate units, generate QR codes for kiosk scanning, and manage "My Units" directly on their devices.  Key Features & Functionality Pre-Gate & Fast Gate: Submit shipment details ahead of time, reducing time spent at the gate kiosk. "My Units" Screen: Track, view, and manage specific unit statuses and locations. Parking Updates: Update assigned parking locations directly, eliminating the need to call dispatchers or find a yard checker. QR Code Scanner: Facilitates swift check-in at the kiosk using a mobile QR code. Emergency Feature: Includes an emergency notification button to request immediate assistance.

Standard Icon buttons are low-emphasis buttons.
They are used for the lowest priority actions, especially when presenting multiple options.

Icon buttons can be placed on a variety of backgrounds. Until the button is interacted with, its container isn’t visible.

Displays labels and page navigation controls at the top of the page. (Use a toolbar to display page actions)
